sentences.en: This outfit was typical of a colonist at that time.
sentences.zh: 这种服装在当时典型的殖民者会穿。

sentences.en: He wrote the article "Psychological Fitness for Colonists in Martian Habitats."
sentences.zh: 他写了一篇题为《火星栖息地殖民者的心理适应》的文章。

sentences.en: The colonists bartered with the natives for fur.
sentences.zh: 那些殖民者与当地人用皮毛进行物物交换。
